Six years ago on Nov. 22, 12-year-old Tamir Rice was killed by police. He would have been 18 this year.

Black children deserve to play, learn, and grow up in safe communities. Tamir should’ve been able to grow up. 

Black Lives Matter. Black Children Matter.
